texts.zh:
我们发现了一处位于[gateway_system.GetName]星系边缘的远古空间站。其残留的强烈亚空间信号表明其可能是一个星门之类的东西——理论上能在类似的空间站间组成网状通路，使舰船能瞬移至星系的不同位置。

假如它真是一个星门的话，现在也因为年久失修而无法使用。不过，如果我们能将其修复，星门拥有者将能激活星系中其他星门，使其能在短短数天穿越极远的距离。
texts.en:
An ancient space station of some kind has been located at the edge of the [gateway_system.GetName] system. The strong residual subspace signature that surrounds the station indicates that it may be a "Gateway" of sorts - part of a theoretical network of similar stations that at some point would have allowed for near-instantaneous travel between different parts of the galaxy.

Assuming this is a Gateway, its current state of disrepair has rendered it unusable. If it could be restored into working order, its owner would potentially be able to access any other functional gateways in the galaxy, enabling travel across huge distances in a matter of days.

texts.zh: 我们又发现了一个被遗弃的传送门，这次的传送门是在[gateway_system.GetName]星系中。和之前的传送门不同，这个传送门并没有被人为改动过且与网络中的其他传送门连接正常。但由于破损严重，此传送门暂时无法使用。
texts.en: We have encountered another abandoned Gateway, this time in the [gateway_system.GetName] system. Unlike the previous one, this Gateway has not been altered in any obvious way and our scans indicate that it is still connected to the rest of the network. However, it is currently inoperable due to its poor condition.

summary.text:
# 遗弃星门 / Abandoned Gateway

- 分类 Category：探索 Exploration · 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-13（已审阅 reviewed）
- 来源 Sources：common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:1239 (on_system_survey → distar.13070); events/distant_stars_events_3.txt:2323 (distar.13070); events/apocalypse_events.txt (apoc.1, the ship-survey version)

## 如何开始 How it starts

on_system_survey：国家获得某星系的勘测状态但并非由科学船亲自勘测，该星系带标志 abandoned_gateway 并有 gateway_ruined 巨型建筑，国家尚无 encountered_first_gateway 标志。

on_system_survey: a country gains surveyed status of a system without a science ship, the system has the star flag abandoned_gateway and a gateway_ruined megastructure, and the country does not yet have encountered_first_gateway.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

单一事件 distar.13070“遗弃星门”：保存星门所在系统（gateway_system），设置 encountered_first_gateway 并记录星门类型为已见；沿用 apoc.1 的文字（若已见过L-星门则用另一段正文），唯一选项无其他效果。

Single event distar.13070 "Abandoned Gateway": saves the gateway system (gateway_system), sets encountered_first_gateway and records the gateway bypass type as seen; it reuses apoc.1's text (a different body if an L-Gate was seen before) and the only option has no further effect.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

唯一事件，无分支。

Single event, no branches.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

正文按是否已见过L-星门变化。

The text varies with whether an L-Gate was seen before.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

已核对 on_action 与事件。它是 apoc.1 的“外国领土内”重复版本；不属于L-星团故事（L-星门由 distar.13080 / apoc.3 处理）。

Checked the on_action and the event. It is the 'foreign territory' duplicate of apoc.1; it is not part of the L-Cluster story (L-Gates are handled by distar.13080 / apoc.3).
